source_quotes: checklist completion = step completion = task completion; AMT expansion included as new items; completed is final; a rerun is a new task instance, graft or branch
No auto-continue past a failure. A failed step PAUSES the task
overlap_check: method_43 (30043) says every failure marks state truthfully; this one is about completion, reruns and pause. Cross-reference only.

payload.name: Work Order Completion Is Final
payload.description: A checklist item, a step and a task complete together and stay complete. A rerun is a new task instance or graft. A failure pauses the work at the exact step so it can resume.

principles.name: Completed is completed
principles.description: History is not reopened; a replay or a rerun adds to it.

principles.name: Failure pauses
principles.description: The system does not walk past a failed step.

heuristics.condition: a UI shows a completed item that can be pressed again
heuristics.action: replace the action with 'rerun as new'

heuristics.condition: a task shows two completion states
heuristics.action: check that the checklist and the step are one record

decision_rules.name: Completion is one thing
decision_rules.condition: a checklist item, step or task finishes
decision_rules.outcome: mark them complete together; checklist completion is step completion is task completion

decision_rules.name: Completed is final
decision_rules.condition: a completed task or step needs to be done again
decision_rules.outcome: do not reopen it; create a new task instance, graft or branch that records its relation to the original (rerun_of)

decision_rules.name: Expansion adds items
decision_rules.outcome: add the expansion as new checklist items or child tasks under the step

decision_rules.name: Pause at the failed step
decision_rules.outcome: pause the task so it can resume from exactly that step, and never continue past the failure

decision_rules.name: Keep replay possible
decision_rules.outcome: keep its record so it can be replayed and edited as a new instance
